verdict.rationale: replica-skill is a Claude Code skill/plugin pack, not an agent itself, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence covers installing it as a plugin, pasting SKILL.md files into a chat, and running local Python scripts that do not touch the network. Nothing in the evidence mentions an MCP server or any endpoint an agent could connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
